core_obligations: Restrict the cosymplectic action to symplectic leaves through the Lagrangian-Legendrian graph condition.
Perform symplectic groupoid reduction leafwise and descend the invariant Reeb vector field.
Construct the normalized reduced one-form and leafwise two-form and show their pullbacks and nondegeneracy give a cosymplectic structure.
proof_roadmap: Symplectic leaf action from the LL graph
Leafwise Mikami-Weinstein reduction and Reeb descent
Construction and pullback characterization of reduced cosymplectic forms
difficulty_reason: The author introduces and uses a Lagrangian-Legendrian graph formulation of cosymplectic groupoid actions, then combines leafwise symplectic reduction with descent of the Reeb field to assemble a global cosymplectic quotient. The source-local leaf-action proof and reduction construction carry the nonroutine geometry.
